Check that the running node is live, or ready to serve, from its status file, without opening the
stores

Usage: dolos health [OPTIONS] <--live|--ready>

Options:
      --live
          Pass while the node runs and its sync is not wedged; a node catching up or retrying a lost
          upstream is live
      --ready
          Pass while the node is live, follows its upstream and is within the lag bound
      --check-ports
          Also connect to each serving port the configuration enables
      --max-write-age-seconds <SECONDS>
          How old the last status write may be; overrides `health.max_write_age_seconds`
      --max-stall-seconds <SECONDS>
          How long the sync may stand still with the upstream ahead; overrides
          `health.max_stall_seconds`
      --max-lag-slots <SLOTS>
          How far behind the upstream's tip a ready node may be; overrides `health.max_lag_slots`
      --max-tip-age-seconds <SECONDS>
          How old the local tip may be for a ready node; overrides `health.max_tip_age_seconds`
      --format <FORMAT>
          How to print the result: text for people, JSON for scripts [default: text] [possible
          values: text, json]
  -c, --config <CONFIG>
          
  -h, --help
          Print help
